full_judgment:
2. The respondents herein, as plaintiffs, instituted the above mentioned Partition Suit No. 491 of 1994. Their case, in short, was that the `Ka' scheduled land appertaining to DS Khatian No. 161 measuring 1.49 acres originally belonged to Alimuddin to the extent of 8 annas share and Abejan and Talejan to the extent of 4 annas share each. That the land of schedule `Kha' and 'Ga' measuring 2.60 acres was the self acquired land of Alimuddin who was the sole owner of these land. That Alimuddin had two sons, namely, Ainuddin by his 1st wife and the defendant Mohosin by his 2nd wife. That Ainuddin died during the life time of his father Alimuddin leaving two daughters, namely, Anguri Khatun the plaintiff No. 1 and Adurijan Nessa. That the said two daughters of Ainuddin were under the care of their grand father Alimuddin. Thereafter A I imuddin died leaving his son Mohoshin and two grand daughters Anguri Khatun and Adurijan Nessa as his heirs. Anguri Khatun and Adurijan Nessa were in possession of 1.14 acres of land of 'Ka' schedule. Subsequently Adurijan Nessa died leaving husband-the plaintiff No. 2 as her sole heir. That the defendant Mohosin got the suit land recorded in SA and RS khatians in his name only. That while the plaintiffs claimed their shaham in the suit property in the year 1994 the defendant refused and hence the suit. 

 16. From the above narration of evidence adduced by both the parties it is evident that the plaintiffs could not prove their case at all that Alimuddin died in 1962 by adducing any acceptable and reliable evidence. The defendant, on the other hand, though could not prove the exact date of death of Alimuddin, but the defendant's evidence, as stated above, have proved that Alimuddin died long before 1962. It appears that the appellate court below, the last court of fact, on meticulous examination of the evidence adduced by both the parties, rightly held that Alimuddin died long before 1962. The appellate court below took into consideration the fact also that in both the SA and RS khatians the suit land has been recorded in the name of the defendant Mohosin only and opined to the effect that the non-recording of the names of the plaintiffs in the SA and RS khatians of the suit land speaks against the case of the plaintiffs and in favour of the case of the defendant.
